summary: Get the MFA state of a user

totp_enabled.description: Is TOTP enabled for this user

backup_codes_remaining.description: Number of remaining backup codes for this user

403.description: Not allowed: API tokens are refused here, use a signed-in session. The answer is an error with the message `API tokens cannot manage users`.

description:
Says whether TOTP is on for a user and how many backup codes are left. The codes themselves are never returned.

Needs: a signed-in session as that user or as an administrator (API tokens are refused)
